commands: echo "run_id=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<none>} attempt=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-<none>}"; git status --porcelain; echo "---base---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main

echo "=== tree grep for stall-observer / stall_observer ==="; git grep -nI -e 'stall-observer' -e 'stall_observer' -e 'stall-observer-scan' -e 'stallobserver' 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '\.changeset/' | cut -c1-160

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before
git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

for f in lib/test/test_python_scripts.py lib/test/test_python_scripts_part4.py lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json .prflow/config.schema.json .prflow/config.json .prflow/config.example.json; do echo "== $f =="; git show ee0e3942ec114e60169ce02a05ff68b657f183da:$f | grep -n "stall.observer\|stall_observer" || echo NONE; done

for f in docs/internal/implement-skill.md docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md docs/internal/operations/cloud-runs.md docs/internal/workflows/triggers.md docs/external/docs/configuration/implementation.md docs/external/docs/configuration/settings.md .prflow/config.schema.json; do echo "== $f =="; git show ee0e3942ec114e60169ce02a05ff68b657f183da:$f | grep -niE "stall[-_]observer|stall_observer" | head; done

for f in .prflow/config.example.json .prflow/config.json .prflow/config.schema.json lib/test/coverage-map-retention-allow.json lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json; do git show ee0e3942ec114e60169ce02a05ff68b657f183da:$f | python3 -c "import sys,json; json.load(sys.stdin); print('OK $f'.replace('\$f','"$f"'))" 2>&1 | tail -1; done

for f in .prflow/config.example.json .prflow/config.json .prflow/config.schema.json lib/test/coverage-map-retention-allow.json lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json lib/test/brand-devflow-buckets.json; do out=$(git show ee0e3942ec114e60169ce02a05ff68b657f183da:"$f" | python3 -c "import sys,json; json.load(sys.stdin); print('OK')" 2>&1 | tail -1); echo "$f: $out"; done

git show ee0e3942ec114e60169ce02a05ff68b657f183da:.changeset/config.json 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---existing changesets---"; git ls-tree ee0e3942ec114e60169ce02a05ff68b657f183da .changeset/ --name-only

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
